```{=html}
<style>
.w041 { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.92rem; }
.w041 .w041-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(120px, 1.6fr) repeat(3, 1fr);
  gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; align-items: stretch;
}
.w041 .w041-head { text-align: center; font-weight: 700; align-self: end; line-height: 1.25; }
.w041 .w041-rowlab {
  display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 4px 6px; font-weight: 600;
  border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px;
}
.w041 .w041-rowlab.w041-rowok { border-color: #2e7d32; color: #2e7d32; }
.w041 .w041-rowlab.w041-rowbad { border-color: #d81e2e; color: #d81e2e; }
.w041 button.w041-cell {
  min-height: 38px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer;
  border: 1.5px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); padding: 0;
}
.w041 button.w041-cell.w041-on { background: #d81e2e; border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w041 .w041-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w041 button.w041-btn {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w041 .w041-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w041 .w041-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w041 .w041-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
.w041 .w041-note { font-size: 0.78rem; font-style: italic; opacity: 0.7; }
.w041 .w041-expl {
  font-size: 0.85rem; opacity: 0.85; border-left: 3px solid #2e7d32;
  padding: 6px 10px; margin-top: 8px;
}
</style>
<div class="w041 iw" id="w041">
  <div class="w041-grid"></div>
  <div class="w041-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w041-btn w041-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w041-btn w041-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w041-btn w041-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w041-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w041-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
  <div class="w041-expl iw-expl" hidden>
    Packet-filter and stateful firewalls judge traffic by address, port and protocol and therefore stop at Layers 3–4; the next-generation firewall adds deep packet inspection and reaches up through Layer 7; and the WAF inspects the HTTP requests of one web application, operating at Layer 7 only. See <a href="#sec-04-firewall-types-ngfw-waf">the section on firewall types, NGFW and WAF</a>.
  </div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w041');
  const grid = root.querySelector('.w041-grid');
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w041-msg');
  const COLS = [
    ['l3', 'L3 Network (IP)'],
    ['l4', 'L4 Transport (ports)'],
    ['l7', 'L7 Application (HTTP)']
  ];
  const ROWS = [
    ['pf', 'Packet-filter firewall', ['l3', 'l4']],
    ['sf', 'Stateful firewall', ['l3', 'l4']],
    ['ngfw', 'Next-gen firewall (NGFW)', ['l3', 'l4', 'l7']],
    ['waf', 'Web app firewall (WAF)', ['l7']]
  ];

  function clearMarks() {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w041-rowlab').forEach(l => l.classList.remove('w041-rowok', 'w041-rowbad'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w041-msg iw-msg';
  }
  // header row
  const corner = document.createElement('div');
  grid.appendChild(corner);
  COLS.forEach(col => {
    const h = document.createElement('div');
    h.className = 'w041-head';
    h.textContent = col[1];
    grid.appendChild(h);
  });
  // tool rows
  ROWS.forEach(row => {
    const lab = document.createElement('div');
    lab.className = 'w041-rowlab';
    lab.dataset.row = row[0];
    lab.textContent = row[1];
    grid.appendChild(lab);
    COLS.forEach(col => {
      const cell = document.createElement('button');
      cell.type = 'button';
      cell.className = 'w041-cell';
      cell.dataset.row = row[0];
      cell.dataset.col = col[0];
      cell.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
      cell.setAttribute('aria-label', row[1] + ' at ' + col[1]);
      cell.addEventListener('click', () => {
        cell.classList.toggle('w041-on');
        cell.setAttribute('aria-pressed', cell.classList.contains('w041-on') ? 'true' : 'false');
        clearMarks();
      });
      grid.appendChild(cell);
    });
  });
  root.querySelector('.w041-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let okRows = 0, touched = 0;
    ROWS.forEach(row => {
      const lab = root.querySelector('.w041-rowlab[data-row="' + row[0] + '"]');
      lab.classList.remove('w041-rowok', 'w041-rowbad');
      const on = [...root.querySelectorAll('.w041-cell[data-row="' + row[0] + '"].w041-on')]
        .map(c => c.dataset.col).sort();
      touched += on.length;
      const want = row[2].slice().sort();
      const same = on.length === want.length && on.every((v, i) => v === want[i]);
      if (same) { lab.classList.add('w041-rowok'); okRows++; }
      else lab.classList.add('w041-rowbad');
    });
    if (okRows === ROWS.length) { msg.textContent = '✓ All correct - the inspection depth of each tool is filled in.'; msg.className = 'w041-msg iw-msg ok'; }
    else if (touched === 0) { msg.textContent = 'Nothing filled in yet - click the cells where each tool operates, then check again.'; msg.className = 'w041-msg iw-msg'; }
    else { msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet - ' + okRows + ' of ' + ROWS.length + ' rows are right; the red rows have too many or too few cells filled.'; msg.className = 'w041-msg iw-msg bad'; }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w041-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    ROWS.forEach(row => {
      COLS.forEach(col => {
        const cell = root.querySelector('.w041-cell[data-row="' + row[0] + '"][data-col="' + col[0] + '"]');
        const on = row[2].includes(col[0]);
        cell.classList.toggle('w041-on', on);
        cell.setAttribute('aria-pressed', on ? 'true' : 'false');
      });
    });
    clearMarks();
    root.querySelectorAll('.w041-rowlab').forEach(l => l.classList.add('w041-rowok'));
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown - reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w041-msg iw-msg ok';
    root.querySelector('.w041-expl').hidden = false;
  });
  root.querySelector('.w041-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    root.querySelectorAll('.w041-cell').forEach(c => {
      c.classList.remove('w041-on');
      c.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
    });
    clearMarks();
    root.querySelector('.w041-expl').hidden = true;
  });
})();
</script>
```
